Solution said 'Q and P have identical leverage — both 1.5× and 1.67×'; the ratios are 1.67× (P), 1.56× (R) and 1.5× (Q), so the note now states them. Option B's analysis called P 'the middle firm'; P is the riskiest (DtD 5.11), so it now says the safest firm first and the riskiest second.
